Score immunopeptidomics samples for overall quality

Source: R/quality-score.R
score_sample_quality.Rd

Computes a per-sample composite quality score (and a traffic-light category) from pep_all, combining several interpretable dimensions: length-window fidelity, 9-mer dominance, anchor-motif clarity, non-tryptic specificity, charge plausibility, depth, and mass accuracy. Each raw metric (qc_metrics_by_sample()) is mapped to a 0-100 sub-score (score_curve()) against either built-in defaults (quality_thresholds_default()) or thresholds calibrated from tagged QC samples (calibrate_thresholds_from_qc()). The composite is the weighted mean of the available sub-scores, so undefined dimensions (e.g. MHC-II anchors, DIA-NN ppm) drop out instead of penalising the sample.

Usage

score_sample_quality(
  pep_all,
  shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
  mhcclass = "MHC1",
  qc_samples = NULL,
  threshold_mode = c("default", "qc_relative"),
  thresholds = NULL,
  weights = NULL
)

Arguments

pep_all

A unified pep_all data frame.

shortpep_range

Length-2 numeric c(min, max) ligand-length window.

mhcclass

"MHC1", "MHC1_mouse" (7-11 AA window, 8/9-mer canonical lengths) or "MHC2"; also selects the default threshold table.

qc_samples

Optional character vector of Sample values flagged as QC controls (e.g. from an annotation QC column). Used to mark samples and, when threshold_mode = "qc_relative", to calibrate thresholds.

threshold_mode

"default" (absolute literature thresholds) or "qc_relative" (thresholds derived from qc_samples). "qc_relative" falls back to defaults if no QC samples are supplied.

thresholds

Optional scoring table overriding the class-appropriate quality_thresholds_default() (which is used when this is NULL).

weights

Optional named numeric vector overriding the weight column of thresholds (names = metric names).

Value

A data frame with one row per Sample: the raw metrics, a score_<metric> column per dimension, composite_score, category, and is_QC. Sorted by descending composite_score.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
score_sample_quality(pep_all, c(8, 13), "MHC1")
score_sample_quality(pep_all, c(8, 13), "MHC1",
                     qc_samples = c("QC_A"), threshold_mode = "qc_relative")
} # }
